original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Accelerate the complete default primary command of PR1624 by exact common-denominator integer dot products, preserving every reached dot value/type, complete certificate and original rejection control.
scope_change_reason: One source-bound fixture and one measured arithmetic bottleneck refine the replay-runtime card. This is implementation work, not a mathematical audit of PR1624.
bottleneck_link: Faster complete exact replays reduce the cost of checking construction candidates; no kappa or supplier improvement is inferred.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified end-to-end improvement. At most two implementation candidates; no expansion of the predecessor theorem.
evidence: Nine alternating fresh-process pairs: medians 0.628149917 s and 0.415995042 s, 33.774561% less wall time. Complete stdout equal with zero failures. Full conformance compares 189904 reached dot values/types and both complete certificates; 65536 rational cases, mutation/capacity/fallback controls and eight rejecting controls pass.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can the same integer-row representation improve another named complete rational replay?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Exact arithmetic replay can dominate the cost of screening new constructions.
open_questions.first_step: Profile that complete command and enumerate its reached widths/types before choosing a bounded adapter.
open_questions.blocked_by: Different mutation patterns, denominator growth and output contracts need new source-bound conformance and timing evidence.
